GreasePencilWeightProximityModifier.use_multiply: Multiplies the new weights with the weights already in the group instead of replacing them.
GreasePencilWeightProximityModifier.use_invert_output: Flips the result, so close points get low weight and far points get high weight.
GreasePencilWeightProximityModifier.target_vertex_group: The vertex group that receives the calculated weights.
GreasePencilWeightProximityModifier.distance_start: Distance at which the weight becomes 0.0. Points at or closer than this get no weight.
GreasePencilWeightProximityModifier.minimum_weight: The lowest weight a point can get. Raise it so far-away points still keep a little weight.
GreasePencilWeightProximityModifier.distance_end: Distance at which the weight becomes 1.0. Points at this distance or farther get full weight.

HookModifier.falloff_type.CURVE: Uses a custom curve you draw to shape the falloff.
HookModifier.falloff_type.SMOOTH: Soft S-shaped fade from full effect to none.
HookModifier.falloff_type.SPHERE: Rounded fade that stays strong near the center and drops fast near the edge.
HookModifier.falloff_type.ROOT: Fades quickly at first, then slowly (like a square root).
HookModifier.falloff_type.INVERSE_SQUARE: Realistic fade like light: strong near the center, drops off fast with distance.
HookModifier.falloff_type.SHARP: Pointy fade: drops steeply near the center, then tails off.
HookModifier.falloff_type.LINEAR: Straight, even fade from the center to the edge.
HookModifier.falloff_type.CONSTANT: Full effect everywhere in range, then nothing outside it.
HookModifier.falloff_radius: Distance from the hook where its pull ends. 0 means no limit, bigger values pull a wider area.
HookModifier.center: The hook's center point, used for the falloff and shown in the viewport.
HookModifier.matrix_inverse: Stores the starting offset between the object and its target so the mesh doesn't jump when hooked.
HookModifier.subtarget: Bone of the target armature that does the hooking (if the target is an armature).
HookModifier.use_falloff_uniform: Corrects for stretched objects so the falloff stays round instead of squashed.
HookModifier.vertex_group: Limits the effect to a vertex group. Heavier weights get more effect, and empty means the whole mesh.
HookModifier.invert_vertex_group: Flips the group's weights, so the effect hits the vertices that were left out instead.

KinematicConstraint._: Inverse Kinematics (IK): move the end of a bone chain (like a hand) and the bones before it bend to follow, like an arm or leg.

KinematicConstraint.owner_space.WORLD: Uses the global world axes, the same for every object in the scene.
KinematicConstraint.owner_space.CUSTOM: Uses the local axes of another object or bone that you pick.
KinematicConstraint.owner_space.POSE: Uses the armature's pose space: positions relative to the armature object, ignoring the bone's rest pose.
KinematicConstraint.owner_space.LOCAL_WITH_PARENT: Uses the bone's rest pose position, but still follows the parent's movement.
KinematicConstraint.owner_space.LOCAL: Uses the object's own local axes (relative to its parent). Good for rig controls.
KinematicConstraint.target_space: Which coordinate system is used to read the target's position, rotation and scale.
KinematicConstraint.target_space.WORLD: Uses the global world axes, the same for every object in the scene.
KinematicConstraint.target_space.CUSTOM: Uses the local axes of another object or bone that you pick.

KinematicConstraint.target_space.LOCAL: Uses the object's own local axes (relative to its parent). Good for rig controls.
KinematicConstraint.target_space.LOCAL_OWNER_ORIENT: Local space of the target bone, but turned to match the constrained bone's orientation.
KinematicConstraint.space_subtarget: Bone (or vertex group) that defines the custom space when a Custom space is chosen.
KinematicConstraint.mute: Turns the constraint off (muted) without deleting it. The eye icon in the panel.
KinematicConstraint.enabled: True when the constraint is currently being applied. Mirrors the eye icon.
KinematicConstraint.show_expanded: Opens or closes this constraint's panel. Only changes how it looks, not the result.
KinematicConstraint.active: Marks this as the constraint currently being edited.
KinematicConstraint.influence: How strongly the constraint applies. 0 means no effect, 1 means full effect, and in between blends.
KinematicConstraint.subtarget: Bone on the target armature that the end of the chain tries to reach.
KinematicConstraint.iterations: How many tries the solver makes each frame. Low is faster but rough, high is more accurate but slower.
KinematicConstraint.pole_subtarget: Bone on the pole armature that decides which way the middle joint (knee/elbow) points.
KinematicConstraint.pole_angle: Rotates the chain around the line to the pole target. Use it to fix a twisted knee or elbow.
KinematicConstraint.weight: For tree-style IK: how much this chain cares about reaching the target position. Higher wins over others.
KinematicConstraint.orient_weight: For tree-style IK: how much this chain cares about matching the target's rotation.
KinematicConstraint.chain_count: How many bones in the chain get moved. 0 means the whole chain up to the root.
KinematicConstraint.use_tail: Includes the tip (tail) of the last bone as the chain end, so the tip reaches the target, not the base.
KinematicConstraint.reference_axis: Whether the location/rotation locks are measured along the bone's axes or the target's axes.
KinematicConstraint.reference_axis.BONE: Locks are measured along the constrained bone's own axes.
KinematicConstraint.reference_axis.TARGET: Locks are measured along the target's axes.
KinematicConstraint.use_location: Makes the chain follow the target's position.
KinematicConstraint.lock_location_x: Locks the X position, so the chain does not try to reach the target along X.
KinematicConstraint.lock_location_y: Locks the Y position, so the chain does not try to reach the target along Y.
KinematicConstraint.lock_location_z: Locks the Z position, so the chain does not try to reach the target along Z.
KinematicConstraint.use_rotation: Makes the end of the chain also copy the target's rotation.
KinematicConstraint.lock_rotation_x: Locks the X rotation, so the chain does not match the target's X rotation.
KinematicConstraint.lock_rotation_y: Locks the Y rotation, so the chain does not match the target's Y rotation.
KinematicConstraint.lock_rotation_z: Locks the Z rotation, so the chain does not match the target's Z rotation.
KinematicConstraint.use_stretch: Lets bones stretch when the target is farther than the chain can reach. Needs stretch set up on the bones.
KinematicConstraint.ik_type: Which IK solving method to use.
KinematicConstraint.ik_type.COPY_POSE: Normal IK: the chain end tries to match the target's position (and rotation).
KinematicConstraint.ik_type.DISTANCE: The chain end stays a set distance from the target instead of touching it.
KinematicConstraint.limit_mode: Used by Distance IK: whether the end stays inside, outside or on the edge of the distance sphere.
KinematicConstraint.limit_mode.LIMITDIST_INSIDE: The end can be anywhere inside the sphere, but not outside it.
KinematicConstraint.limit_mode.LIMITDIST_OUTSIDE: The end can be anywhere outside the sphere, but not inside it.
KinematicConstraint.limit_mode.LIMITDIST_ONSURFACE: The end is kept exactly on the sphere's surface.
KinematicConstraint.distance: Radius of the sphere used by Distance IK. Bigger means the end stays farther from the target.

LimitScaleConstraint.use_max_x: Turns on the upper scale limit on X.
LimitScaleConstraint.use_max_y: Turns on the upper scale limit on Y.
LimitScaleConstraint.use_max_z: Turns on the upper scale limit on Z.
LimitScaleConstraint.min_x: Lowest scale allowed on X. The object can't go below this.
LimitScaleConstraint.min_y: Lowest scale allowed on Y. The object can't go below this.
LimitScaleConstraint.min_z: Lowest scale allowed on Z. The object can't go below this.
LimitScaleConstraint.max_x: Highest scale allowed on X. The object can't go above this.
LimitScaleConstraint.max_y: Highest scale allowed on Y. The object can't go above this.
LimitScaleConstraint.max_z: Highest scale allowed on Z. The object can't go above this.
LimitScaleConstraint.use_transform_limit: Also applies the limit while you grab, rotate or scale, so tools can't push past it.

LockedTrackConstraint._: Makes the object point one axis at the target while spinning only around a locked axis, like a turret that can only swivel.
LockedTrackConstraint.owner_space: Which coordinate system is used to read the constrained object's own position, rotation and scale.
LockedTrackConstraint.owner_space.WORLD: Uses the global world axes, the same for every object in the scene.
LockedTrackConstraint.owner_space.CUSTOM: Uses the local axes of another object or bone that you pick.
LockedTrackConstraint.owner_space.POSE: Uses the armature's pose space: positions relative to the armature object, ignoring the bone's rest pose.
LockedTrackConstraint.owner_space.LOCAL_WITH_PARENT: Uses the bone's rest pose position, but still follows the parent's movement.
LockedTrackConstraint.owner_space.LOCAL: Uses the object's own local axes (relative to its parent). Good for rig controls.
LockedTrackConstraint.target_space: Which coordinate system is used to read the target's position, rotation and scale.
LockedTrackConstraint.target_space.WORLD: Uses the global world axes, the same for every object in the scene.
LockedTrackConstraint.target_space.CUSTOM: Uses the local axes of another object or bone that you pick.
LockedTrackConstraint.target_space.POSE: Uses the armature's pose space: positions relative to the armature object, ignoring the bone's rest pose.
LockedTrackConstraint.target_space.LOCAL_WITH_PARENT: Uses the bone's rest pose position, but still follows the parent's movement.
LockedTrackConstraint.target_space.LOCAL: Uses the object's own local axes (relative to its parent). Good for rig controls.
LockedTrackConstraint.target_space.LOCAL_OWNER_ORIENT: Local space of the target bone, but turned to match the constrained bone's orientation.
LockedTrackConstraint.space_subtarget: Bone (or vertex group) that defines the custom space when a Custom space is chosen.
LockedTrackConstraint.mute: Turns the constraint off (muted) without deleting it. The eye icon in the panel.
LockedTrackConstraint.enabled: True when the constraint is currently being applied. Mirrors the eye icon.
LockedTrackConstraint.show_expanded: Opens or closes this constraint's panel. Only changes how it looks, not the result.
LockedTrackConstraint.active: Marks this as the constraint currently being edited.
LockedTrackConstraint.influence: How strongly the constraint applies. 0 means no effect, 1 means full effect, and in between blends.
LockedTrackConstraint.head_tail: Where on the target bone to aim. 0 is the bone's head (base), 1 is its tail (tip), 0.5 is the middle.
LockedTrackConstraint.use_bbone_shape: Follows the curved B-Bone segments when picking the Head/Tail spot, instead of the straight bone.
LockedTrackConstraint.subtarget: Choose a specific bone or vertex group on the target, so the constraint follows that part.
LockedTrackConstraint.track_axis: The object's axis that points at the target.
LockedTrackConstraint.track_axis.TRACK_X: Points the object's +X axis at the target.
LockedTrackConstraint.track_axis.TRACK_Y: Points the object's +Y axis at the target.
LockedTrackConstraint.track_axis.TRACK_Z: Points the object's +Z axis at the target.
LockedTrackConstraint.track_axis.TRACK_NEGATIVE_X: Points the object's -X axis at the target.
LockedTrackConstraint.track_axis.TRACK_NEGATIVE_Y: Points the object's -Y axis at the target.
LockedTrackConstraint.track_axis.TRACK_NEGATIVE_Z: Points the object's -Z axis at the target.
LockedTrackConstraint.lock_axis: The axis the object spins around, and the one that is kept pointing up.
LockedTrackConstraint.lock_axis.LOCK_X: Spins only around the X axis.
LockedTrackConstraint.lock_axis.LOCK_Y: Spins only around the Y axis.
LockedTrackConstraint.lock_axis.LOCK_Z: Spins only around the Z axis.

MaintainVolumeConstraint.owner_space: Which coordinate system is used to read the constrained object's own position, rotation and scale.
MaintainVolumeConstraint.owner_space.WORLD: Uses the global world axes, the same for every object in the scene.
MaintainVolumeConstraint.owner_space.CUSTOM: Uses the local axes of another object or bone that you pick.
MaintainVolumeConstraint.owner_space.POSE: Uses the armature's pose space: positions relative to the armature object, ignoring the bone's rest pose.
MaintainVolumeConstraint.owner_space.LOCAL_WITH_PARENT: Uses the bone's rest pose position, but still follows the parent's movement.
MaintainVolumeConstraint.owner_space.LOCAL: Uses the object's own local axes (relative to its parent). Good for rig controls.
MaintainVolumeConstraint.target_space: Which coordinate system is used to read the target's position, rotation and scale.
MaintainVolumeConstraint.target_space.WORLD: Uses the global world axes, the same for every object in the scene.
MaintainVolumeConstraint.target_space.CUSTOM: Uses the local axes of another object or bone that you pick.
MaintainVolumeConstraint.target_space.POSE: Uses the armature's pose space: positions relative to the armature object, ignoring the bone's rest pose.
MaintainVolumeConstraint.target_space.LOCAL_WITH_PARENT: Uses the bone's rest pose position, but still follows the parent's movement.
MaintainVolumeConstraint.target_space.LOCAL: Uses the object's own local axes (relative to its parent). Good for rig controls.
MaintainVolumeConstraint.target_space.LOCAL_OWNER_ORIENT: Local space of the target bone, but turned to match the constrained bone's orientation.
MaintainVolumeConstraint.space_subtarget: Bone (or vertex group) that defines the custom space when a Custom space is chosen.
MaintainVolumeConstraint.mute: Turns the constraint off (muted) without deleting it. The eye icon in the panel.
MaintainVolumeConstraint.enabled: True when the constraint is currently being applied. Mirrors the eye icon.
MaintainVolumeConstraint.show_expanded: Opens or closes this constraint's panel. Only changes how it looks, not the result.
MaintainVolumeConstraint.active: Marks this as the constraint currently being edited.
MaintainVolumeConstraint.influence: How strongly the constraint applies. 0 means no effect, 1 means full effect, and in between blends.
MaintainVolumeConstraint.free_axis: The axis you are free to scale. The other two axes automatically adjust to keep volume.
MaintainVolumeConstraint.free_axis.SAMEVOL_X: X is the free axis, Y and Z shrink or grow to compensate.
MaintainVolumeConstraint.free_axis.SAMEVOL_Y: Y is the free axis, X and Z shrink or grow to compensate.
MaintainVolumeConstraint.free_axis.SAMEVOL_Z: Z is the free axis, X and Y shrink or grow to compensate.
MaintainVolumeConstraint.mode: How the constraint treats the scaling on the non-free axes.
MaintainVolumeConstraint.mode.STRICT: Volume is always preserved, overriding any scaling you do on the other axes.
MaintainVolumeConstraint.mode.UNIFORM: Volume is kept when the object is scaled evenly on the non-free axes.
MaintainVolumeConstraint.mode.SINGLE_AXIS: Volume is kept when only a single non-free axis is scaled.
MaintainVolumeConstraint.volume: The volume the object should keep. 1 means the same volume as at rest.

MaskModifier._: Hides parts of a mesh using a vertex group or an armature's bones, like cutting out only the pieces you want to see.
MaskModifier.show_viewport: Shows the modifier's result in the 3D viewport. Turn off to hide its effect while you work.
MaskModifier.show_render: Uses this modifier in final renders. Turn off to keep the effect out of your render.
MaskModifier.show_in_editmode: Shows the modifier's result while you are in Edit Mode.
MaskModifier.show_on_cage: Makes the editing points sit on the modified shape, so you edit what you see after the modifier.
MaskModifier.show_expanded: Opens or closes this panel in the list. Only changes how it looks, not the result.
MaskModifier.is_active: Marks this as the selected modifier in the list. Tools that act on one modifier use this one.
MaskModifier.use_pin_to_last: Pins this modifier to the bottom of the stack so new modifiers get added above it.
MaskModifier.use_apply_on_spline: On curves, applies this and earlier deform modifiers to the spline's control points instead of the filled shape.
MaskModifier.mode: Whether the visible part comes from a vertex group or from the bones of an armature.
MaskModifier.mode.VERTEX_GROUP: Keeps only the vertices that belong to a vertex group.
MaskModifier.mode.ARMATURE: Keeps only the parts of the mesh controlled by the bones of an armature.
MaskModifier.vertex_group: The vertex group (or bone group) that decides what stays visible.
MaskModifier.invert_vertex_group: Flips the mask, so everything NOT in the group stays and the group is hidden.
MaskModifier.use_smooth: Cuts faces along the weight edge instead of removing whole faces, for a smooth border.
MaskModifier.threshold: Weights above this value stay visible. Raise it to hide more, lower it to keep more.

MeshCacheModifier._: Plays back saved animation from an external file (MDD or PC2) onto a mesh, so the mesh moves like it did in another program.
MeshCacheModifier.show_viewport: Shows the modifier's result in the 3D viewport. Turn off to hide its effect while you work.
MeshCacheModifier.show_render: Uses this modifier in final renders. Turn off to keep the effect out of your render.
MeshCacheModifier.show_in_editmode: Shows the modifier's result while you are in Edit Mode.
MeshCacheModifier.show_on_cage: Makes the editing points sit on the modified shape, so you edit what you see after the modifier.
MeshCacheModifier.show_expanded: Opens or closes this panel in the list. Only changes how it looks, not the result.
MeshCacheModifier.is_active: Marks this as the selected modifier in the list. Tools that act on one modifier use this one.
MeshCacheModifier.use_pin_to_last: Pins this modifier to the bottom of the stack so new modifiers get added above it.
MeshCacheModifier.use_apply_on_spline: On curves, applies this and earlier deform modifiers to the spline's control points instead of the filled shape.
MeshCacheModifier.cache_format: File type of the saved animation.
MeshCacheModifier.cache_format.MDD: Point cache format common in other 3D programs.
MeshCacheModifier.cache_format.PC2: Point cache format used by 3ds Max and others.
MeshCacheModifier.interpolation: How frames between the saved ones are filled in.
MeshCacheModifier.interpolation.NONE: No blending: shows the nearest saved frame, which can look steppy.
MeshCacheModifier.interpolation.LINEAR: Blends smoothly between two saved frames.
MeshCacheModifier.time_mode: How the playback position is chosen.
MeshCacheModifier.time_mode.FRAME: Picks the cache frame by frame number, ignoring the cache's own timing.
MeshCacheModifier.time_mode.TIME: Picks the cache position using time in seconds.
MeshCacheModifier.time_mode.FACTOR: Picks the position with a value from 0 (start) to 1 (end).
MeshCacheModifier.play_mode: Whether playback follows the scene timeline or this modifier's own timing.
MeshCacheModifier.play_mode.SCENE: Uses the scene's current frame to play the cache.
MeshCacheModifier.play_mode.CUSTOM: Uses the timing values set in this modifier instead of the scene.
MeshCacheModifier.deform_mode: How the saved motion is combined with the mesh underneath.
MeshCacheModifier.deform_mode.OVERWRITE: Replaces the mesh's vertex positions with the saved ones.
MeshCacheModifier.deform_mode.INTEGRATE: Adds the saved movement on top of what earlier modifiers already did.
MeshCacheModifier.filepath: Location of the animation file on your computer.
MeshCacheModifier.factor: How much of the saved motion is applied. 0 is none, 1 is full.
MeshCacheModifier.vertex_group: Limits the effect to a vertex group. Heavier weights get more effect, and empty means the whole mesh.
MeshCacheModifier.invert_vertex_group: Flips the group's weights, so the effect hits the vertices that were left out instead.
MeshCacheModifier.forward_axis: Which direction counts as forward in the file, so the mesh isn't rotated wrong.
MeshCacheModifier.up_axis: Which direction counts as up in the file, so the mesh isn't rotated wrong.
MeshCacheModifier.flip_axis: Flips the axes to fix a mesh that comes in mirrored or turned the wrong way.
MeshCacheModifier.frame_start: Shifts the playback start. Positive delays the animation, negative starts it earlier.
MeshCacheModifier.frame_scale: Playback speed in custom frame mode. 1 is normal, 2 is twice as fast, 0.5 is half speed.
MeshCacheModifier.eval_frame: The frame of the cache to show, counting from 0, when using Custom frame mode.
MeshCacheModifier.eval_time: The time in seconds to show from the cache, when using Custom time mode.
MeshCacheModifier.eval_factor: A position from 0 (start) to 1 (end) to show, when using Custom factor mode.

MeshDeformModifier.show_viewport: Shows the modifier's result in the 3D viewport. Turn off to hide its effect while you work.
MeshDeformModifier.show_render: Uses this modifier in final renders. Turn off to keep the effect out of your render.
MeshDeformModifier.show_in_editmode: Shows the modifier's result while you are in Edit Mode.
MeshDeformModifier.show_on_cage: Makes the editing points sit on the modified shape, so you edit what you see after the modifier.
MeshDeformModifier.show_expanded: Opens or closes this panel in the list. Only changes how it looks, not the result.
MeshDeformModifier.is_active: Marks this as the selected modifier in the list. Tools that act on one modifier use this one.
MeshDeformModifier.use_pin_to_last: Pins this modifier to the bottom of the stack so new modifiers get added above it.
MeshDeformModifier.use_apply_on_spline: On curves, applies this and earlier deform modifiers to the spline's control points instead of the filled shape.
MeshDeformModifier.invert_vertex_group: Flips the group's weights, so the effect hits the vertices that were left out instead.
MeshDeformModifier.vertex_group: Limits the effect to this vertex group. Empty means the whole mesh.
MeshDeformModifier.precision: Detail of the binding grid. Higher is more accurate but uses more memory and time.
MeshDeformModifier.use_dynamic_bind: Recalculates the binding live so it works on top of other deformers. Slower and uses more memory.

MeshSequenceCacheModifier._: Plays back an animated Alembic or USD cache on a mesh, so geometry from another program moves in Blender.
MeshSequenceCacheModifier.show_viewport: Shows the modifier's result in the 3D viewport. Turn off to hide its effect while you work.
MeshSequenceCacheModifier.show_render: Uses this modifier in final renders. Turn off to keep the effect out of your render.
MeshSequenceCacheModifier.show_in_editmode: Shows the modifier's result while you are in Edit Mode.
MeshSequenceCacheModifier.show_on_cage: Makes the editing points sit on the modified shape, so you edit what you see after the modifier.
MeshSequenceCacheModifier.show_expanded: Opens or closes this panel in the list. Only changes how it looks, not the result.
MeshSequenceCacheModifier.is_active: Marks this as the selected modifier in the list. Tools that act on one modifier use this one.
MeshSequenceCacheModifier.use_pin_to_last: Pins this modifier to the bottom of the stack so new modifiers get added above it.
MeshSequenceCacheModifier.use_apply_on_spline: On curves, applies this and earlier deform modifiers to the spline's control points instead of the filled shape.
MeshSequenceCacheModifier.object_path: Path of the object inside the cache file whose animation is read.
MeshSequenceCacheModifier.read_data: Which kinds of data are read from the cache file.
MeshSequenceCacheModifier.use_vertex_interpolation: Blends vertex positions between cache frames for smoother motion at in-between times.
MeshSequenceCacheModifier.velocity_scale: Scales the stored velocity values. Higher exaggerates motion blur and similar effects.

MeshToVolumeModifier._: Turns a mesh into a volume (a 3D cloud of tiny cubes called voxels), so you can use it with smoke, fog or volume shaders.
MeshToVolumeModifier.show_viewport: Shows the modifier's result in the 3D viewport. Turn off to hide its effect while you work.
MeshToVolumeModifier.show_render: Uses this modifier in final renders. Turn off to keep the effect out of your render.
MeshToVolumeModifier.show_in_editmode: Shows the modifier's result while you are in Edit Mode.
MeshToVolumeModifier.show_on_cage: Makes the editing points sit on the modified shape, so you edit what you see after the modifier.
MeshToVolumeModifier.show_expanded: Opens or closes this panel in the list. Only changes how it looks, not the result.
MeshToVolumeModifier.is_active: Marks this as the selected modifier in the list. Tools that act on one modifier use this one.
MeshToVolumeModifier.use_pin_to_last: Pins this modifier to the bottom of the stack so new modifiers get added above it.
MeshToVolumeModifier.use_apply_on_spline: On curves, applies this and earlier deform modifiers to the spline's control points instead of the filled shape.
MeshToVolumeModifier.resolution_mode: Choose how the voxel size is set: by count or by size.
MeshToVolumeModifier.resolution_mode.VOXEL_AMOUNT: Set roughly how many voxels fit along one axis.
MeshToVolumeModifier.resolution_mode.VOXEL_SIZE: Set the side length of each voxel directly.
MeshToVolumeModifier.voxel_size: Side length of each voxel. Smaller gives finer detail but is much heavier on memory.
MeshToVolumeModifier.voxel_amount: About how many voxels go along one axis. Higher gives finer detail but is slower.
MeshToVolumeModifier.interior_band_width: Thickness of the soft gradient inside the surface. Bigger gives a thicker, softer shell.
MeshToVolumeModifier.density: How dense the new volume is. Higher looks thicker and darker.

MirrorModifier._: Creates a mirrored copy of your mesh across an axis, so you only model half and get a symmetrical whole.
MirrorModifier.show_viewport: Shows the modifier's result in the 3D viewport. Turn off to hide its effect while you work.
MirrorModifier.show_render: Uses this modifier in final renders. Turn off to keep the effect out of your render.
MirrorModifier.show_in_editmode: Shows the modifier's result while you are in Edit Mode.
MirrorModifier.show_on_cage: Makes the editing points sit on the modified shape, so you edit what you see after the modifier.
MirrorModifier.show_expanded: Opens or closes this panel in the list. Only changes how it looks, not the result.
MirrorModifier.is_active: Marks this as the selected modifier in the list. Tools that act on one modifier use this one.
MirrorModifier.use_pin_to_last: Pins this modifier to the bottom of the stack so new modifiers get added above it.
MirrorModifier.use_apply_on_spline: On curves, applies this and earlier deform modifiers to the spline's control points instead of the filled shape.
MirrorModifier.use_axis: Turns on mirroring along each axis (X, Y, Z). Tick the ones you want mirrored.
MirrorModifier.use_bisect_axis: Cuts the mesh at the mirror plane and removes the part on the far side, then mirrors the rest.
MirrorModifier.use_bisect_flip_axis: Flips which side of the cut is kept when bisecting.
MirrorModifier.use_clip: Stops vertices from crossing the mirror line while you edit, so the center stays closed.
MirrorModifier.use_mirror_vertex_groups: Also mirrors vertex groups, swapping names like .L and .R on the copy.
MirrorModifier.use_mirror_merge: Joins vertices that are very close to the mirror line, so the halves connect without a seam.
MirrorModifier.use_mirror_u: Mirrors the U direction of the UV map on the copy, so textures flip along with the shape.
MirrorModifier.use_mirror_v: Mirrors the V direction of the UV map on the copy, so textures flip along with the shape.
MirrorModifier.use_mirror_udim: Mirrors UVs around the center of each UDIM tile instead of the whole 0 to 1 space.
MirrorModifier.mirror_offset_u: Shifts the U mirror line away from the middle (0.5). Use it to line up mirrored UVs.
MirrorModifier.mirror_offset_v: Shifts the V mirror line away from the middle (0.5). Use it to line up mirrored UVs.
MirrorModifier.offset_u: Moves the mirrored copy's UVs sideways on the U axis. Useful to give the copy its own texture space.
MirrorModifier.offset_v: Moves the mirrored copy's UVs up or down on the V axis. Useful to give the copy its own texture space.
MirrorModifier.merge_threshold: How close a vertex must be to its mirror twin to be merged. Bigger merges more, tiny keeps almost all.
MirrorModifier.bisect_threshold: Distance from the mirror plane inside which vertices count as on the plane when bisecting.

MultiresModifier.show_viewport: Shows the modifier's result in the 3D viewport. Turn off to hide its effect while you work.
MultiresModifier.show_render: Uses this modifier in final renders. Turn off to keep the effect out of your render.
MultiresModifier.show_in_editmode: Shows the modifier's result while you are in Edit Mode.
MultiresModifier.show_on_cage: Makes the editing points sit on the modified shape, so you edit what you see after the modifier.
MultiresModifier.show_expanded: Opens or closes this panel in the list. Only changes how it looks, not the result.
MultiresModifier.is_active: Marks this as the selected modifier in the list. Tools that act on one modifier use this one.
MultiresModifier.use_pin_to_last: Pins this modifier to the bottom of the stack so new modifiers get added above it.
MultiresModifier.use_apply_on_spline: On curves, applies this and earlier deform modifiers to the spline's control points instead of the filled shape.
MultiresModifier.uv_smooth: How UV maps are smoothed when the mesh is subdivided.
MultiresModifier.uv_smooth.NONE: UVs are not smoothed and keep sharp edges.
MultiresModifier.uv_smooth.PRESERVE_CORNERS: UVs are smoothed, but sharp corners on borders stay sharp.
MultiresModifier.uv_smooth.PRESERVE_CORNERS_AND_JUNCTIONS: Smooths UVs but keeps corners and the spots where UV islands meet.
MultiresModifier.uv_smooth.PRESERVE_CORNERS_JUNCTIONS_AND: Same as the previous option, and also keeps inward-bending corners sharp.
MultiresModifier.uv_smooth.PRESERVE_BOUNDARIES: UVs are smoothed, but the outer borders of UV islands stay fixed.
MultiresModifier.uv_smooth.SMOOTH_ALL: Smooths UVs and their borders everywhere.
MultiresModifier.quality: Accuracy of the vertex positions. Low is faster but less exact, high is more precise but slower.
MultiresModifier.boundary_smooth: How the open edges of the mesh are smoothed.
MultiresModifier.boundary_smooth.PRESERVE_CORNERS: Smooths open edges but keeps their corners sharp.
MultiresModifier.boundary_smooth.ALL: Smooths open edges including the corners.
MultiresModifier.levels: Subdivision level shown in the 3D viewport. Higher is smoother but slower.
MultiresModifier.sculpt_levels: Subdivision level used while sculpting. Higher gives finer detail but is heavier.
MultiresModifier.render_levels: Subdivision level used in final renders. Usually set higher than the viewport level.
MultiresModifier.filepath: Where displacement data is stored when saved to an external file.
MultiresModifier.show_only_control_edges: Hides the extra edges made by subdividing and shows only the original ones, for a cleaner view.
MultiresModifier.use_creases: Uses edge crease values to keep chosen edges sharp after subdividing.
MultiresModifier.use_custom_normals: Carries your custom normals through to the subdivided mesh.
MultiresModifier.use_sculpt_base_mesh: Makes sculpt tools move the low-poly base mesh while previewing the detail on top.

NodesModifier.use_apply_on_spline: On curves, applies this and earlier deform modifiers to the spline's control points instead of the filled shape.
NodesModifier.bake_directory: Folder on your computer where baked node data is saved when stored on disk.
NodesModifier.bake_target: Where baked data from the node tree is kept.
NodesModifier.bake_target.PACKED: Stores the baked data inside the .blend file.
NodesModifier.bake_target.DISK: Stores the baked data in a folder on your drive.
NodesModifier.show_group_selector: Shows the node group picker at the top of the panel.
NodesModifier.show_manage_panel: Shows the Manage panel that holds bake and cache tools.
NodesModifier.open_output_attributes_panel: Remembers whether the Output Attributes panel is open. Only changes the panel look.
NodesModifier.open_manage_panel: Remembers whether the Manage panel is open. Only changes the panel look.
NodesModifier.open_bake_panel: Remembers whether the Bake panel is open. Only changes the panel look.
NodesModifier.open_named_attributes_panel: Remembers whether the Named Attributes panel is open. Only changes the panel look.
NodesModifier.open_bake_data_blocks_panel: Remembers whether the Bake Data-Blocks panel is open. Only changes the panel look.
NodesModifier.open_warnings_panel: Remembers whether the Warnings panel is open. Only changes the panel look.

NormalEditModifier._: Changes the direction the surface normals point, which controls how light shades the mesh without changing its shape.
NormalEditModifier.show_viewport: Shows the modifier's result in the 3D viewport. Turn off to hide its effect while you work.
NormalEditModifier.show_render: Uses this modifier in final renders. Turn off to keep the effect out of your render.
NormalEditModifier.show_in_editmode: Shows the modifier's result while you are in Edit Mode.
NormalEditModifier.show_on_cage: Makes the editing points sit on the modified shape, so you edit what you see after the modifier.
NormalEditModifier.show_expanded: Opens or closes this panel in the list. Only changes how it looks, not the result.
NormalEditModifier.is_active: Marks this as the selected modifier in the list. Tools that act on one modifier use this one.
NormalEditModifier.use_pin_to_last: Pins this modifier to the bottom of the stack so new modifiers get added above it.
NormalEditModifier.use_apply_on_spline: On curves, applies this and earlier deform modifiers to the spline's control points instead of the filled shape.
NormalEditModifier.mode: How the new normals are generated.
NormalEditModifier.mode.RADIAL: Normals point outward from a center, like a sphere. Handy to smooth shading on heads or bushes.
NormalEditModifier.mode.DIRECTIONAL: All normals point toward a target object, as if looking at it.
NormalEditModifier.offset: Moves the center the normals radiate from, away from the object's origin.
NormalEditModifier.mix_mode: How the new normals combine with the existing ones.
NormalEditModifier.mix_mode.COPY: Replaces the old normals with the new ones.
NormalEditModifier.mix_mode.ADD: Adds the new normals to the old ones.
NormalEditModifier.mix_mode.SUB: Subtracts the new normals from the old ones.
NormalEditModifier.mix_mode.MUL: Multiplies the old and new normals together.
NormalEditModifier.mix_factor: How much of the new normals are used. 0 keeps the old ones, 1 uses only the new ones.
NormalEditModifier.mix_limit: Biggest angle allowed between the old and new normals. Lower keeps results close to the originals.
NormalEditModifier.no_polynors_fix: Stops faces from flipping when their normals no longer match their direction.
NormalEditModifier.vertex_group: Limits the effect to this vertex group. Heavier weights change the normals more.
NormalEditModifier.invert_vertex_group: Flips the group, so the effect hits the vertices that were left out instead.
NormalEditModifier.use_direction_parallel: Makes all normals point the same way, from the object's origin to the target's center.

ObjectSolverConstraint._: Makes the object follow the camera-tracking solution of a movie clip object, so it sticks to the real footage.

SolidifyModifier.solidify_mode.NON_MANIFOLD: Slower but handles messy or complex meshes without breaking.
SolidifyModifier.thickness: How thick the shell is. Bigger is thicker, negative goes the other way.
SolidifyModifier.thickness_clamp: Stops the thickness from growing too much on short edges. 0 turns it off.
SolidifyModifier.use_thickness_angle_clamp: Reduces thickness at sharp angles to avoid spikes and overlapping.
SolidifyModifier.thickness_vertex_group: Thickness used where vertex group weight is zero. 0 makes those spots flat.
SolidifyModifier.offset: Where the shell sits. -1 grows inward, 1 grows outward, 0 is centered.
SolidifyModifier.edge_crease_inner: Crease value given to inner edges. Higher keeps them sharper when subdivided.
SolidifyModifier.edge_crease_outer: Crease value given to outer edges. Higher keeps them sharper when subdivided.
SolidifyModifier.edge_crease_rim: Crease value given to the rim edges. Higher keeps them sharper when subdivided.
SolidifyModifier.material_offset: Shifts the material number of the new faces, so the inside can use a different material.
SolidifyModifier.material_offset_rim: Shifts the material number of the rim faces, so the sides can use another material.
SolidifyModifier.vertex_group: Limits thickness to this vertex group. Heavier weights make thicker walls.
SolidifyModifier.shell_vertex_group: Vertex group that gets the new shell geometry assigned to it.
SolidifyModifier.rim_vertex_group: Vertex group that gets the new rim geometry assigned to it.
SolidifyModifier.use_rim: Fills in the edges between inner and outer surfaces so the thick edge is closed.
SolidifyModifier.use_even_offset: Keeps the thickness the same at sharp corners. Slower and may be off for some meshes.
SolidifyModifier.use_quality_normals: Computes better normals so thickness looks more even. Slower.
SolidifyModifier.invert_vertex_group: Flips the group, so the thick parts are the ones left out of it.

SolidifyModifier.nonmanifold_thickness_mode.FIXED: Simple thickness that can look thinner on slanted faces.
SolidifyModifier.nonmanifold_thickness_mode.EVEN: Keeps thickness even, which fixes thin spots on slanted faces.
SolidifyModifier.nonmanifold_thickness_mode.CONSTRAINTS: Uses constraints to keep thickness correct, best for tricky shapes.
SolidifyModifier.nonmanifold_boundary_mode: How the open outer edge of the mesh is shaped in Complex mode.
SolidifyModifier.nonmanifold_boundary_mode.NONE: No change to the edge shape.

SplineIKConstraint.owner_space.LOCAL_WITH_PARENT: Uses the bone's rest pose position, but still follows the parent's movement.
SplineIKConstraint.owner_space.LOCAL: Uses the object's own local axes (relative to its parent). Good for rig controls.

SplineIKConstraint.target_space.WORLD: Uses the global world axes, the same for every object in the scene.
SplineIKConstraint.target_space.CUSTOM: Uses the local axes of another object or bone that you pick.

SplineIKConstraint.target_space.LOCAL_OWNER_ORIENT: Local space of the target bone, but turned to match the constrained bone's orientation.
SplineIKConstraint.space_subtarget: Bone (or vertex group) that defines the custom space when a Custom space is chosen.
SplineIKConstraint.mute: Turns the constraint off (muted) without deleting it. The eye icon in the panel.
SplineIKConstraint.enabled: True when the constraint is currently being applied. Mirrors the eye icon.
SplineIKConstraint.show_expanded: Opens or closes this constraint's panel. Only changes how it looks, not the result.
SplineIKConstraint.active: Marks this as the constraint currently being edited.
SplineIKConstraint.influence: How strongly the constraint applies. 0 means no effect, 1 means full effect, and in between blends.
SplineIKConstraint.chain_count: How many bones in the chain follow the curve, counted from the tip back toward the root.
SplineIKConstraint.joint_bindings: Advanced: the relative positions of the joints along the curve. Leave alone unless you know why.
SplineIKConstraint.use_chain_offset: Moves the whole chain away from the curve's start, based on the root bone's position.
SplineIKConstraint.use_even_divisions: Spaces bones evenly along the curve, ignoring how long each bone is.
SplineIKConstraint.use_curve_radius: Uses the curve's thickness (radius) to scale the bones' width.
SplineIKConstraint.xz_scale_mode: How the bones' thickness (X and Z) changes as they are stretched.
SplineIKConstraint.xz_scale_mode.NONE: Does not scale the bone's X and Z axes.
SplineIKConstraint.xz_scale_mode.BONE_ORIGINAL: Keeps the bone's original X and Z scaling.
SplineIKConstraint.xz_scale_mode.INVERSE_PRESERVE: Scales thickness the opposite way of the stretch, to keep volume.
SplineIKConstraint.xz_scale_mode.VOLUME_PRESERVE: Scales thickness with a volume formula so the bone keeps its volume.
SplineIKConstraint.y_scale_mode: How the bones' length (Y) is scaled to the curve.
SplineIKConstraint.y_scale_mode.FIT_CURVE: Stretches bones so the chain exactly fits the whole curve.
SplineIKConstraint.use_original_scale: Applies the volume rule on top of the bone's original scaling.
SplineIKConstraint.bulge: How much bones thicken when squashed and thin when stretched. 1 keeps volume, 0 does nothing.
SplineIKConstraint.use_bulge_min: Sets a lower limit on how thin the bone can get.
SplineIKConstraint.use_bulge_max: Sets an upper limit on how thick the bone can get.
SplineIKConstraint.bulge_min: Smallest allowed volume change factor when stretching.
SplineIKConstraint.bulge_max: Largest allowed volume change factor when squashing.
SplineIKConstraint.bulge_smooth: Softens how the min and max limits kick in. Higher means a smoother stop.

SubsurfModifier.levels: Subdivision level shown in the viewport. Each +1 multiplies the faces by about four.

SubsurfModifier.adaptive_space.OBJECT: Subdivides until edges reach a set length in the object's own units.

VolumeDisplaceModifier._: Pushes a volume's density around using a texture, like making smoke or clouds look lumpy or wispy.
VolumeDisplaceModifier.show_viewport: Shows the modifier's result in the 3D viewport. Turn off to hide its effect while you work.
VolumeDisplaceModifier.show_render: Uses this modifier in final renders. Turn off to keep the effect out of your render.
VolumeDisplaceModifier.show_in_editmode: Shows the modifier's result while you are in Edit Mode.
VolumeDisplaceModifier.show_on_cage: Makes the editing points sit on the modified shape, so you edit what you see after the modifier.
VolumeDisplaceModifier.show_expanded: Opens or closes this panel in the list. Only changes how it looks, not the result.
VolumeDisplaceModifier.is_active: Marks this as the selected modifier in the list. Tools that act on one modifier use this one.
VolumeDisplaceModifier.use_pin_to_last: Pins this modifier to the bottom of the stack so new modifiers get added above it.
VolumeDisplaceModifier.use_apply_on_spline: On curves, applies this and earlier deform modifiers to the spline's control points instead of the filled shape.
VolumeDisplaceModifier.strength: How far the texture displaces the volume. 0 does nothing, higher distorts more.
VolumeDisplaceModifier.texture_map_mode: How the texture is placed on the volume.
VolumeDisplaceModifier.texture_map_mode.LOCAL: Uses the volume's own local coordinates.
VolumeDisplaceModifier.texture_map_mode.GLOBAL: Uses world coordinates, so the texture stays put as the volume moves.
VolumeDisplaceModifier.texture_map_mode.OBJECT: Uses the local coordinates of another object you pick.
VolumeDisplaceModifier.texture_mid_level: Texture value that counts as no displacement. Above pushes out, below pushes in.
VolumeDisplaceModifier.texture_sample_radius: Sample size when reading the texture. Smaller is faster but may look noisy.

VolumeToMeshModifier._: Turns a volume (like smoke or a cloud) into a mesh surface where the density passes a threshold.
VolumeToMeshModifier.show_viewport: Shows the modifier's result in the 3D viewport. Turn off to hide its effect while you work.
VolumeToMeshModifier.show_render: Uses this modifier in final renders. Turn off to keep the effect out of your render.
VolumeToMeshModifier.show_in_editmode: Shows the modifier's result while you are in Edit Mode.
VolumeToMeshModifier.show_on_cage: Makes the editing points sit on the modified shape, so you edit what you see after the modifier.
VolumeToMeshModifier.show_expanded: Opens or closes this panel in the list. Only changes how it looks, not the result.
VolumeToMeshModifier.is_active: Marks this as the selected modifier in the list. Tools that act on one modifier use this one.
VolumeToMeshModifier.use_pin_to_last: Pins this modifier to the bottom of the stack so new modifiers get added above it.
VolumeToMeshModifier.use_apply_on_spline: On curves, applies this and earlier deform modifiers to the spline's control points instead of the filled shape.
VolumeToMeshModifier.threshold: Voxels with a value above this are inside the mesh. Higher makes a smaller shape.
VolumeToMeshModifier.adaptivity: Simplifies flat areas to cut face count. 0 keeps everything, higher removes more faces.
VolumeToMeshModifier.use_smooth_shade: Makes the new faces look smooth instead of faceted.
VolumeToMeshModifier.grid_name: Name of the grid in the volume that is converted into a mesh.
VolumeToMeshModifier.resolution_mode: How the detail of the new mesh is chosen.
VolumeToMeshModifier.resolution_mode.VOXEL_AMOUNT: Set roughly how many voxels fit along one axis.
VolumeToMeshModifier.resolution_mode.VOXEL_SIZE: Set the side length of each voxel directly.
VolumeToMeshModifier.voxel_size: Side length of each voxel. Smaller gives finer detail but is heavier.
VolumeToMeshModifier.voxel_amount: About how many voxels go along one axis. Higher gives finer detail but is slower.

WarpModifier._: Moves part of a mesh from one object or bone toward another, with a falloff, like pinching or stretching clay.
WarpModifier.show_viewport: Shows the modifier's result in the 3D viewport. Turn off to hide its effect while you work.
WarpModifier.show_render: Uses this modifier in final renders. Turn off to keep the effect out of your render.
WarpModifier.show_in_editmode: Shows the modifier's result while you are in Edit Mode.
WarpModifier.show_on_cage: Makes the editing points sit on the modified shape, so you edit what you see after the modifier.
WarpModifier.show_expanded: Opens or closes this panel in the list. Only changes how it looks, not the result.
WarpModifier.is_active: Marks this as the selected modifier in the list. Tools that act on one modifier use this one.
WarpModifier.use_pin_to_last: Pins this modifier to the bottom of the stack so new modifiers get added above it.
WarpModifier.use_apply_on_spline: On curves, applies this and earlier deform modifiers to the spline's control points instead of the filled shape.
WarpModifier.bone_to: Bone where the warp ends, defining the offset.
WarpModifier.strength: How strongly the warp moves the mesh. 0 does nothing, higher moves more.
WarpModifier.falloff_type: Shape of the fade from the warp's center to the edge of its radius.
WarpModifier.falloff_type.NONE: No falloff: everything inside the radius gets the full effect.
WarpModifier.falloff_type.CURVE: Uses a custom curve you draw to shape the falloff.
WarpModifier.falloff_type.SMOOTH: Soft S-shaped fade from full effect to none.
WarpModifier.falloff_type.SPHERE: Rounded fade that stays strong near the center and drops fast near the edge.
WarpModifier.falloff_type.ROOT: Fades quickly at first, then slowly (like a square root).
WarpModifier.falloff_type.INVERSE_SQUARE: Realistic fade like light: strong near the center, drops off fast with distance.
WarpModifier.falloff_type.SHARP: Pointy fade: drops steeply near the center, then tails off.
WarpModifier.falloff_type.LINEAR: Straight, even fade from the center to the edge.
WarpModifier.falloff_type.CONSTANT: Full effect everywhere in range, then nothing outside it.
WarpModifier.falloff_radius: Distance where the warp fades to nothing. Bigger affects a wider area.
WarpModifier.use_volume_preserve: Keeps volume when rotations are used, so the mesh doesn't thin out.
WarpModifier.vertex_group: Limits the effect to this vertex group. Heavier weights move more.
WarpModifier.invert_vertex_group: Flips the group, so the effect hits the vertices that were left out instead.
WarpModifier.texture_coords: How a texture is placed on the mesh to control the warp.
WarpModifier.texture_coords.LOCAL: Uses the object's own generated coordinates, so the texture sticks to the mesh.
WarpModifier.texture_coords.GLOBAL: Uses world coordinates, so the texture stays put as the object moves.
WarpModifier.texture_coords.OBJECT: Uses the local coordinates of another object you choose.
WarpModifier.texture_coords.UV: Uses the mesh's UV map to place the texture.
WarpModifier.uv_layer: Name of the UV map used when the texture mapping is set to UV.
WarpModifier.texture_coords_bone: Bone whose position and rotation move the texture.

WaveModifier._: Makes ripples travel across a mesh like waves on water, moving points up and down over time.
WaveModifier.show_viewport: Shows the modifier's result in the 3D viewport. Turn off to hide its effect while you work.
WaveModifier.show_render: Uses this modifier in final renders. Turn off to keep the effect out of your render.
WaveModifier.show_in_editmode: Shows the modifier's result while you are in Edit Mode.
WaveModifier.show_on_cage: Makes the editing points sit on the modified shape, so you edit what you see after the modifier.
WaveModifier.show_expanded: Opens or closes this panel in the list. Only changes how it looks, not the result.
WaveModifier.is_active: Marks this as the selected modifier in the list. Tools that act on one modifier use this one.
WaveModifier.use_pin_to_last: Pins this modifier to the bottom of the stack so new modifiers get added above it.
WaveModifier.use_apply_on_spline: On curves, applies this and earlier deform modifiers to the spline's control points instead of the filled shape.
WaveModifier.use_x: Waves travel along the X axis.
WaveModifier.use_y: Waves travel along the Y axis.
WaveModifier.use_cyclic: Makes the wave repeat forever instead of passing once.
WaveModifier.use_normal: Moves points along their normals (the way the surface faces) instead of along fixed axes.
WaveModifier.time_offset: Shifts the wave in time. Positive delays the start, negative starts it earlier.
WaveModifier.lifetime: How many frames the wave lasts. 0 means it never ends.
WaveModifier.damping_time: How many frames the wave takes to fade out after its lifetime ends.
WaveModifier.falloff_radius: Distance from the start point where the wave fades out. 0 means no fade.
WaveModifier.start_position_x: X position where the wave starts.
WaveModifier.start_position_y: Y position where the wave starts.
WaveModifier.vertex_group: Limits the wave to this vertex group. Heavier weights get taller waves.
WaveModifier.invert_vertex_group: Flips the group, so the effect hits the vertices that were left out instead.
WaveModifier.speed: How fast the wave travels. Negative sends it toward the start point.
WaveModifier.height: How tall the wave is. Higher gives bigger ups and downs.
WaveModifier.width: Distance between waves. Bigger gives long lazy waves, smaller gives tight ripples.
WaveModifier.narrowness: How pointy the wave tops are compared with its base. Higher gives sharper peaks.
WaveModifier.texture_coords: How a texture is placed on the mesh to control the wave.
WaveModifier.texture_coords.LOCAL: Uses the object's own generated coordinates, so the texture sticks to the mesh.
WaveModifier.texture_coords.GLOBAL: Uses world coordinates, so the texture stays put as the object moves.
WaveModifier.texture_coords.OBJECT: Uses the local coordinates of another object you choose.
WaveModifier.texture_coords.UV: Uses the mesh's UV map to place the texture.
WaveModifier.uv_layer: Name of the UV map used when the texture mapping is set to UV.
WaveModifier.texture_coords_bone: Bone whose position and rotation move the texture.

WeightedNormalModifier._: Adjusts normals using face size or angle, giving clean shading on hard-surface models without extra edge loops.
WeightedNormalModifier.show_viewport: Shows the modifier's result in the 3D viewport. Turn off to hide its effect while you work.
WeightedNormalModifier.show_render: Uses this modifier in final renders. Turn off to keep the effect out of your render.
WeightedNormalModifier.show_in_editmode: Shows the modifier's result while you are in Edit Mode.
WeightedNormalModifier.show_on_cage: Makes the editing points sit on the modified shape, so you edit what you see after the modifier.
WeightedNormalModifier.show_expanded: Opens or closes this panel in the list. Only changes how it looks, not the result.
WeightedNormalModifier.is_active: Marks this as the selected modifier in the list. Tools that act on one modifier use this one.
WeightedNormalModifier.use_pin_to_last: Pins this modifier to the bottom of the stack so new modifiers get added above it.
WeightedNormalModifier.use_apply_on_spline: On curves, applies this and earlier deform modifiers to the spline's control points instead of the filled shape.
WeightedNormalModifier.weight: Strength of the weighting. 50 is neutral, higher favors bigger faces, lower favors smaller ones.
WeightedNormalModifier.mode: What decides how much each face counts toward the shading.
WeightedNormalModifier.mode.FACE_AREA: Bigger faces have more say in the final shading.
WeightedNormalModifier.mode.CORNER_ANGLE: Faces with wider corners at that point have more say.
WeightedNormalModifier.mode.FACE_AREA_WITH_ANGLE: Uses both face size and corner angle together.
WeightedNormalModifier.thresh: Weights closer than this value count as equal. Raise it to blend more faces.
WeightedNormalModifier.keep_sharp: Keeps edges that were sharp on the original mesh sharp.
WeightedNormalModifier.vertex_group: Limits the effect to this vertex group. Heavier weights change the shading more.
WeightedNormalModifier.invert_vertex_group: Flips the group, so the effect hits the vertices that were left out instead.
WeightedNormalModifier.use_face_influence: Uses each face's Face Influence setting when weighting.

WeldModifier._: Merges vertices that sit very close together into one, fixing doubles and cracks.
WeldModifier.show_viewport: Shows the modifier's result in the 3D viewport. Turn off to hide its effect while you work.
WeldModifier.show_render: Uses this modifier in final renders. Turn off to keep the effect out of your render.
WeldModifier.show_in_editmode: Shows the modifier's result while you are in Edit Mode.
WeldModifier.show_on_cage: Makes the editing points sit on the modified shape, so you edit what you see after the modifier.
WeldModifier.show_expanded: Opens or closes this panel in the list. Only changes how it looks, not the result.
WeldModifier.is_active: Marks this as the selected modifier in the list. Tools that act on one modifier use this one.
WeldModifier.use_pin_to_last: Pins this modifier to the bottom of the stack so new modifiers get added above it.
WeldModifier.use_apply_on_spline: On curves, applies this and earlier deform modifiers to the spline's control points instead of the filled shape.
WeldModifier.mode: How vertices are chosen for merging.
WeldModifier.mode.ALL: Merges every pair of vertices closer than the distance, anywhere in the mesh.
WeldModifier.mode.CONNECTED: Only merges vertices that are already joined by an edge.
WeldModifier.merge_threshold: Vertices closer than this distance get merged. Higher merges more.
WeldModifier.vertex_group: Limits merging to this vertex group.
WeldModifier.invert_vertex_group: Flips the group, so the effect hits the vertices that were left out instead.
WeldModifier.loose_edges: Also collapses edges with no faces, like sewing edges in cloth.

WireframeModifier._: Turns the mesh edges into thick solid bars, like a wireframe cage, while the faces become holes.
WireframeModifier.show_viewport: Shows the modifier's result in the 3D viewport. Turn off to hide its effect while you work.
WireframeModifier.show_render: Uses this modifier in final renders. Turn off to keep the effect out of your render.
WireframeModifier.show_in_editmode: Shows the modifier's result while you are in Edit Mode.
WireframeModifier.show_on_cage: Makes the editing points sit on the modified shape, so you edit what you see after the modifier.
WireframeModifier.show_expanded: Opens or closes this panel in the list. Only changes how it looks, not the result.
WireframeModifier.is_active: Marks this as the selected modifier in the list. Tools that act on one modifier use this one.
WireframeModifier.use_pin_to_last: Pins this modifier to the bottom of the stack so new modifiers get added above it.
WireframeModifier.use_apply_on_spline: On curves, applies this and earlier deform modifiers to the spline's control points instead of the filled shape.
WireframeModifier.thickness: How thick the wire bars are. Bigger makes chunkier bars.
WireframeModifier.thickness_vertex_group: Thickness used where vertex group weight is zero. 0 removes the wire there.
WireframeModifier.offset: Where the wire sits. -1 grows inward, 1 grows outward, 0 is centered.
WireframeModifier.use_replace: Removes the original faces so only the wire remains.
WireframeModifier.use_boundary: Also adds wire around open edges and face borders.
WireframeModifier.use_even_offset: Scales the thickness at corners so the bars stay even in width.
WireframeModifier.use_relative_offset: Scales the thickness by the size of nearby faces, so big faces get thicker bars.
WireframeModifier.use_crease: Adds crease to the joints for cleaner results when followed by subdivision.
WireframeModifier.crease_weight: How strong the crease is when Crease is on. Higher keeps joints sharper.
WireframeModifier.material_offset: Shifts the material number of the wire faces, so the wire can use another material.
WireframeModifier.vertex_group: Limits the wire to this vertex group. Heavier weights make thicker bars.
WireframeModifier.invert_vertex_group: Flips the group, so the effect hits the vertices that were left out instead.
